answer: Require every agent identity to post a bond before it can earn, and audit a random sample of its claimed work: established peers re-check the work, and a failed audit forfeits the bond and burns the identity. Like a river cutting a channel, honest work deepens trust over time, while fake work is exposed by the sample. One bad check sends a ripple through an attacker's whole farm, since each of a thousand Sybils needs its own bond and faces the same audit lottery, so forging identities costs more than any reward they could extract, and only the ridge of verified, attested work earns payouts.
